description_en: Initiates an intelligent outbound call based on a large language model
description_zh: 基于大模型的智能外呼
name: LlmSmartCall

parameters.help_en: The called number that receives the intelligent outbound call
parameters.help_zh: 接收智能外呼的被叫号码
parameters.name: called_number

parameters.help_en:
The caller number. This parameter is required and supports only numbers in the Chinese mainland. Go to the Real Number Management (https://dyvmsnext.console.aliyun.com/number/list/normal) page of Voice Service to view the number.


If you use a self-managed line, you must pass the number of the self-managed line
parameters.help_zh:
主叫号码，为必填参数，仅支持中国内地号码。请前往语音服务真实号管理 (https://dyvmsnext.console.aliyun.com/number/list/normal)界面查看号码。


若您使用的是自带线路，则需要传自带线路号码
parameters.name: caller_number

parameters.help_en: The code of the large language model application. You can view the code on the Large Language Model Application Management (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/engine/llmApp) page
parameters.help_zh: 大模型应用编码。在大模型应用管理 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/engine/llmApp)界面查看
parameters.name: application_code

parameters.help_en: The opening remark variables. Go to the Large Language Model Application Management (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/engine/llmApp) page and click Details to view the opening remark variables of the large language model application that you created
parameters.help_zh: 开场白变量。请前往大模型应用管理 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/engine/llmApp)界面单击详情查看您创建的大模型开场白变量
parameters.name: start_word_param

parameters.help_en: The prompt variables. Go to the Large Language Model Application Management (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/engine/llmApp) page and click Details to view the prompt variables of the large language model application that you created
parameters.help_zh: Prompt提示词变量。请前往大模型应用管理 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/engine/llmApp)界面单击详情查看您创建的Prompt提示词变量
parameters.name: prompt_param

parameters.help_en: The ID reserved for the caller. This ID is returned to the caller in the receipt message. When the large language model gateway requests the customer model, this parameter is passed to the customer model. The length is 1 to 15 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 预留给调用方使用的 ID，最终会通过回执消息将此 ID 带回给调用方，同时大模型网关请求客户模型时会将此参数带给客户模型，长度为 1~15 个字节
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en:
The custom business parameters. When you call this API operation, you can pass custom parameters to the large language model gateway. When the large language model gateway requests the customer model, this parameter is passed to the customer model.

Model Studio workflow application: Parameter passing (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/invoke-workflow-application/#6e644d5a7b3ia). Example: `biz_params = {"city": "Hangzhou"}`

Model Studio agent application: Pass custom parameters (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/call-single-agent-application/#b774db7cdc0aa). Example:
`
biz_params = {
  "user_prompt_params": "{\"city\":\"Beijing\"}"
}
`
parameters.help_zh:
自定义业务参数，客户调用此接口时可以将自定义参数传递给大模型网关，大模型网关请求客户模型时会将此参数带给客户模型。

百炼工作流应用地址：参数传递 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/invoke-workflow-application/#6e644d5a7b3ia)。如：`biz_params = {"city": "杭州"}`

百炼智能体应用地址：传递自定义参数 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/call-single-agent-application/#b774db7cdc0aa)。如：
`
biz_params = {
  "user_prompt_params": "{\"city\":\"北京\"}"
}
`
parameters.name: biz_param

parameters.help_en:
The extension number of the X number. The extension number cannot exceed 5 digits.

<notice>This parameter is required only in AXN extension number mode. If no extension number exists, do not specify this parameter.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
X号码的分机号码，不超过5位。

<notice>仅在AXN分机号模式下需要填写，如果不存在分机号，请务必不要填写。></notice>
parameters.name: extension

parameters.help_en:
The maximum call duration. The call is automatically disconnected after the timeout period. Unit: seconds.

Maximum value: 3600.
Minimum value: 600
parameters.help_zh:
最大通话时长，超时后自动挂断。单位：秒。

最大取值：3600s。
最小取值：600s
parameters.name: session_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The voice code for text-to-speech (TTS) playback.


If you do not specify this parameter, the voice code configured for the large language model application is used by default.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2926668.html API operation to query all voice codes
parameters.help_zh:
TTS 播放时的音色编码。


不设置值时，默认取大模型应用配置的音色编码。
支持通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2926668.html接口查看全部音色编码
parameters.name: tts_voice_code

parameters.help_en:
The speech rate for TTS playback.


Valid values: -200 to 200. Default value: 0.
If you do not specify this parameter, the speech rate configured for the large language model application is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
TTS 播放时的声音速度。


取值范围：-200~200，默认值为0。
不设置值时，默认取大模型应用配置的声音速度
parameters.name: tts_speed

parameters.help_en:
The volume for TTS playback.

Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 0.
If you do not specify this parameter, the volume configured for the large language model application is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
TTS 播放的音量。

取值范围：0~100，默认值为0。
不设置值时，默认取大模型应用配置的音量
parameters.name: tts_volume

parameters.help_en:
The code of the self-managed line.

If you need to use a self-managed line, contact operations to enable this feature. After the self-managed line is approved, the line code is returned. If no line code is returned, do not specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
用户自带线路编码。

如果需要使用自带线路，请联系运营开通此功能；自带线路审核通过后会返回线路编码，若无，请不要设置值
parameters.name: customer_line_code

CallId.description_en: The unique receipt ID of the call

Code.description_en: The status code of the request. A value of OK indicates that the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 请求状态码。返回OK代表请求成功

Message.description_en: The description of the status code
